text:
Sasha: FYI customer-tier p99 jumped ~2.3x on /v1/generate after the 03:22 deploy. Dashboard p99 panel shows a big spike but the raw histogram panel doesn't line up. https://dash.redwood/queries/abc123

Liam: I see it too on the global p99. Could be a rollup/windowing mismatch vs raw buckets. Which dashboard did the customer reference?

Nina: Support forwarded repro steps and a trace id 0x4f2. Logs show repeated auth-proxy 504s around 03:21:58, then retries. Potentially inflating tail.

Samir: Two quick hypotheses: 1) the rollup view uses 1h aggregated buckets (smoothing), 2) autoscaler pulled down some fast replicas and requests hit slower fallback instances. Need to check events + instance-level histograms.

ops-bot: New deploy: inference-v2 at 03:20 by jess (rollout 100%).

Julia: Reproduced locally with simple curl loop — intermittent ~2s responses. Repro: 
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null; done
```
Sometimes one request hits a slow worker.

Liam: Query I ran: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, instance))
```
Grouped by instance you can see a few outliers. If you aggregate across instances before quantile you get a different p99 number.

Sasha: Support says raw-hist panel has bucket width 50ms but the rollup panel uses 100ms buckets and 5m -> 1h rollup. Explains small deltas but not a 2x jump.

Nina: Also noticed kv_cache_miss_total spiked at ~03:20 -> more cold starts for the model, which would add tail latency (KV miss => reload).

Samir: Immediate mitigations we can do quickly: 1) scale up dedicated inference pool +20% (buy more headroom), 2) flip rollout back to canary or revert inference-v2, 3) route heavy customers to dedicated capacity fallback. Which do we want now?

Julia: I'm scaling dedicated pool +20% now. Samir, can you open the customer notify ticket and add a temporary routing rule to send affected customer IDs to dedicated? I'll also change the dashboard to show raw histograms (no rollup) until we reconcile.

Liam: Long term: standardize quantile derivation — compute per-instance quantiles with sample-weighted combine or use raw bucket sums before histogram_quantile. Add to runbook and docs. I'll file an RFC.

Sasha: TL;DR: short-term: scale and route; switch dashboard to raw buckets; Samir will coordinate a revert/canary; Julia scaling live. I'll add trace + repro to the ticket and ping affected accounts. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scaling action initiated by Julia: dedicated-pool +20% (job 7843).
